name: Elder Omarch
text: Welcome! I am Elder Omarch, keeper of workspaces.

name: Elder Omarch
text: Omarchy has 10 workspaces. Super+1 through Super+0 to jump.

name: Elder Omarch
text: Super+Tab cycles next, Super+Shift+Tab cycles previous.

name: Elder Omarch
text: Super+Ctrl+Tab returns to your former workspace.

name: Elder Omarch
text: Super+Shift+1-0 moves a window to another workspace (it follows).

name: Elder Omarch
text: Super+Shift+Alt+1-0 moves a window silently (stays on current).

name: Elder Omarch
text: Super+L toggles dwindle vs scrolling layout per-workspace.

name: Elder Omarch
text: Dwindle: all windows visible, shrinks to fit.

name: Elder Omarch
text: Scrolling: windows side-by-side beyond screen edge.

name: Elder Omarch
text: Super+S toggles the Scratchpad, a hidden overlay workspace.

name: Elder Omarch
text: Super+Alt+S sends a window to the scratchpad.

name: Elder Omarch
text: Super+G toggles window grouping. Grouped windows share tile space.

name: Elder Omarch
text: Super+Alt+Tab cycles windows within a group.

name: Elder Omarch
text: Super+Ctrl+Left/Right moves between grouped windows.
recommendation: You now know navigation! Head to the Forest to learn all keybinds.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: I am the Blacksmith! I forge windows into place.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Windows tile automatically. Super+W closes focused window.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+T toggles tiling/floating mode.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+F fullscreen. Super+Ctrl+F tiled fullscreen.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+Alt+F full width (keeps top bar).

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+O pops window out as a sticky float.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+J toggles split direction (horizontal/vertical).

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+P toggles pseudo style (natural vs stretch).

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+Arrow keys focus adjacent windows.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+Shift+Arrow swaps windows in that direction.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Resize: Super+Minus/Equal expands/shrinks left.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+Shift+Minus/Equal expands/shrinks up.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Add Alt for smaller steps, Ctrl for bigger steps.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+Alt+Home saves width, Super+Home restores.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+Ctrl+Backspace forces single window to square.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+Shift+Backspace toggles window gaps.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+Backspace toggles window transparency.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+Left drag moves window. Super+Right drag resizes.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Alt+Tab cycles windows on workspace.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Ctrl+Alt+Tab cycles focus through monitors.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+Ctrl+Delete toggles laptop display on/off.

name: Blacksmith Tiling
text: Super+Ctrl+Alt+Delete mirrors displays.
recommendation: Window mastery complete! Visit the Cave to configure your system.

name: Merchant Theme
text: I am Merchant Theme! I deal in beauty and system control.

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Ctrl+Shift+Space opens the Theme picker (22 themes).

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Ctrl+Space cycles theme backgrounds.

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Shift+Space toggles the top bar on/off.

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Ctrl+N toggles Night Light (blue filter).

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Ctrl+I toggles idle lock (no auto-lock when off).

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Ctrl+L locks the computer.

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Space opens the Omarchy Menu (main hub).

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Alt+Space opens the Apps Menu.

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Escape opens System Menu (suspend, restart, etc.).

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Ctrl+O opens the Toggle Menu.

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Ctrl+H opens the Hardware Menu.

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+, dismisses notifications. Super+Shift+, dismiss all.

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Ctrl+, toggles notification silencing.

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Ctrl+R sets a reminder. Super+Ctrl+Alt+R sees all.

name: Merchant Theme
text: Super+Ctrl+Alt+T shows time. Super+Ctrl+Alt+B shows battery.
recommendation: Style and system mastered! Check out the Workshop for tools and themes.

name: Signpost
text:
LAUNCHING APPS:
Super+Return: Terminal
Super+Alt+Return: Tmux terminal
Super+Shift+Return: Browser
Super+Shift+Alt+B: Incognito browser
Super+Shift+F: File Manager
Super+Shift+N: Neovim

name: Signpost
text:
MORE APPS:
Super+Shift+M: Music (Spotify)
Super+Shift+Alt+M: Music (cliamp)
Super+Shift+D: Docker (LazyDocker)
Super+Shift+O: Obsidian
Super+Shift+X: X (Twitter)
Super+Shift+Y: YouTube
Super+Shift+S: Google Maps

name: Signpost
text:
AI & COMMUNICATION:
Super+Shift+A: AI (ChatGPT)
Super+Shift+Alt+A: AI (Grok)
Super+Shift+G: Signal
Super+Shift+Alt+G: WhatsApp
Super+Shift+Ctrl+G: Messenger
Super+Shift+E: Email (HEY)
Super+Shift+C: Calendar (HEY)

name: Signpost
text:
CLIPBOARD & INPUT:
Super+C: Copy
Super+X: Cut
Super+V: Paste
Super+Ctrl+V: Clipboard history
Super+Ctrl+E: Emoji picker
Super+Ctrl+Q: Calculator
CapsLock+Space+Space: Em dash

name: Signpost
text:
SCREENSHOTS & RECORDING:
Print: Screenshot
Alt+Print: Screen record (start/stop)
Super+Print: Color picker
Super+Ctrl+Print: OCR text extract
Super+Ctrl+X: Start/stop dictation
F9: Push-to-talk dictation
Super+Ctrl+C: Capture menu

name: Signpost
text:
NOTIFICATIONS & REMINDERS:
Super+,: Dismiss notification
Super+Shift+,: Dismiss all
Super+Ctrl+,: Silence notifications
Super+Alt+,: Invoke last notification
Super+Ctrl+R: Set reminder
Super+Ctrl+Alt+R: See all reminders
Super+Ctrl+Shift+R: Clear all reminders

name: Signpost
text:
SYSTEM PANELS:
Super+Ctrl+A: Audio
Super+Ctrl+W: Network/WiFi
Super+Ctrl+B: Bluetooth
Super+Ctrl+D: Display
Super+Ctrl+P: Power
Super+Ctrl+Alt+D: Calendar
Super+Ctrl+T: Activity monitor (btop)

name: Cave Guard
text: Halt! This is the Cave of Settings.

name: Cave Guard
text: Here you can configure every aspect of your system.

name: Cave Guard
text: From Super+Space menu, access all settings:

name: Cave Guard
text: Monitors, Keybindings, Input, Network DNS,

name: Cave Guard
text: Default apps, Plugins, Security, and Hyprland config.
recommendation: Settings explored! Return to the Village or visit the Workshop.

name: Network Keeper
text: NETWORKING: NetworkManager backend.

name: Network Keeper
text: Super+Ctrl+W opens WiFi panel.

name: Network Keeper
text: nmtui for terminal network management.

name: Network Keeper
text: omarchy network password <iface> prints WiFi password.

name: Network Keeper
text: omarchy network speedtest down/up for speed tests.

name: Network Keeper
text: omarchy dns to see/set DNS (Cloudflare, Google, Custom).

name: Network Keeper
text: WiFi QR sharing: Setup > Network > QR Code.

name: Network Keeper
text: Firewall on by default, blocks incoming traffic.

name: Network Keeper
text: Tailscale available: Install > Service > Tailscale.
recommendation: Network configured! Head to the Workshop to explore tools and themes.

name: Display Keeper
text: MONITORS: Auto-extend on connect.

name: Display Keeper
text: Super+/ steps monitor scaling up (1x/1.25x/1.6x/2x/3x/4x).

name: Display Keeper
text: Super+Alt+/ steps scaling down.

name: Display Keeper
text: omarchy display text size <9-20> adjusts text.

name: Display Keeper
text: Brightness keys adjust display brightness.

name: Display Keeper
text: Shift+Brightness for max/min. Alt+Brightness for 1%.

name: Display Keeper
text: Config: ~/.config/hypr/monitors.lua

name: Display Keeper
text: Laptop display: Super+Ctrl+Delete toggles on/off.

name: Display Keeper
text: Mirror displays: Super+Ctrl+Alt+Delete.
recommendation: Display mastered! Return to the Village to continue your journey.

name: Tinkerer
text: Welcome to the Workshop! I am the Tinkerer.

name: Tinkerer
text: 22 built-in themes: Tokyo Night, Catppuccin, Gruvbox,

name: Tinkerer
text: Nord, Rose Pine, Ethereal, Everforest, Hackerman,

name: Tinkerer
text: Osaka Jade, Kanagawa, Lumon, Miasma, Matte Black,

name: Tinkerer
text: Vantablack, Ristretto, Retro 82, Flexoki Light,

name: Tinkerer
text: Catppuccin Latte, White, and more at omarchy.org/themes.

name: Tinkerer
text: Each theme styles: desktop, terminal, neovim, btop,

name: Tinkerer
text: Chromium, bar, menu, notifications, lock screen.

name: Tinkerer
text: Custom backgrounds per theme in ~/.config/omarchy/backgrounds/.

name: Tinkerer
text: More themes at omarchy.org/themes/
recommendation: Themes explored! Talk to the Shell Master or Bar Master.

name: Shell Master
text: SHELL TOOLS included in Omarchy:

name: Shell Master
text: fzf (ff): fuzzy find files with preview.

name: Shell Master
text: Ctrl+R: fuzzy search command history.

name: Shell Master
text: Zoxide: smart cd that remembers directories.

name: Shell Master
text: ripgrep (rg): fast content search.

name: Shell Master
text: eza: enhanced ls with icons (ls, lt, lsa, lta).

name: Shell Master
text: fd: easier find replacement.

name: Shell Master
text: bat: cat with syntax highlighting.

name: Shell Master
text: tldr: concise man page examples.

name: Shell Master
text: yt-dlp: download video from YouTube.

name: Shell Master
text: try: date-stamped experiment dirs in ~/Work/tries.
recommendation: Tools mastered! Visit the Tinkerer or Bar Master next.

name: Bar Master
text: THE BAR can be top, bottom, left, or right.

name: Bar Master
text: Super+Shift+Space toggles bar visibility.

name: Bar Master
text: Widgets: Menu, Workspaces, Clock, Weather, Audio,

name: Bar Master
text: Bluetooth, Network, Power, Display, Tray, Media.

name: Bar Master
text: Click Clock for calendar. Right-click to cycle format.

name: Bar Master
text: Click Audio for volume panel. Scroll for volume.

name: Bar Master
text: Click Weather for forecast popup.

name: Bar Master
text: Click Media for play/pause. Scroll for next/prev.

name: Bar Master
text: Configure in ~/.config/omarchy/shell.json.

name: Bar Master
text: omarchy bar position bottom/left/right/top.

name: Bar Master
text: omarchy bar defaults resets to shipped layout.
recommendation: Bar configured! You have mastered the Workshop. Return to the Village!
